card.title: Explore the reconstructed reservoir with visible controls
card.body: Reservoir Scope 0.9.0 adds Start/Pause, Step, Send pulse, next-step parameter controls, independent recurrence and repeated forcing, optional sensory observation, exact contribution inspection and replayable applied settings. Shared core and native lifecycle checks pass. Four numbered stage experiments remain available. All execution and recordings stay in the research project; no being or live service changed.
card.source: Mike's September 9 hands-on native Essentials request

log.title: Add hands-on Essentials exploration
log.body: Implemented the paced reservoir workspace and meaningful inspection of forcing, recurrent drive, leak and resulting state. Repeated external input and recurrent connections have separate controls and recorded semantics. Board mirroring remains pending.
